cards.title: Shape the silhouette
cards.choose_when: The shape or a cutout is wrong even with a flat material.
actions: Block the largest form at its intended dimensions before beveling or shading.
For a through-hole, cut a real opening; keep the cutter editable.
Inspect the outline and negative space from two intended views.
cards.first_check: Read the Dimensions fields and compare the longest side with the brief before adding detail.
cards.check: Background shows through the opening at delivery size in both views.
cards.if_failed: Widen the cutter just enough to keep the gap visible.
cards.without_tools: Rotate the blockout yourself and share both views; I cannot verify clearance from a description.
cards.example: Model the handle hole; paint the flush label.

cards.title: Frame an architectural bay
cards.choose_when: The camera must explain a space, entrance or repeated module.
actions: Mark the exit and set a level camera at the intended eye height.
Repeat one bay with linked duplicates at a fixed pitch.
Place a bench for scale and render the view in clay.
cards.first_check: In camera view, the marked exit is visible and the vertical sides of a pier do not converge.
cards.check: The exit reads without textures; the bench outline clears the nearest pier.
cards.if_failed: Slide the bench sideways until its outline clears the pier.
cards.without_tools: Inspect the clay view through the active camera yourself; I cannot verify the projected gap.
cards.example: Measure pitch between origins, but clear width between inner faces.

cards.title: Read a surface under light
cards.choose_when: The outline works, but the finish or texture scale looks wrong.
actions: Put a beveled sample beside the part under the same grazing light.
For sheen change only Principled Roughness; for fine relief change only Bump Strength.
Compare highlight width or pore depth in the same camera crop at delivery size.
cards.first_check: A highlight crosses both the test sample and the part in the same frame.
cards.check: The requested finish changes without moving the highlight source or changing the silhouette.
cards.if_failed: Return to the original render and isolate roughness from bump.
cards.without_tools: Render the two finishes from one camera; I cannot verify the difference without both images.
cards.example: Use Bump for limestone pores; model a chip that breaks the edge.

cards.title: Keep a scattered path open
cards.choose_when: Placement must obey a rule when a seed changes.
actions: Mark the path as an exclusion band on the terrain.
Feed the allowed region into Distribute Points on Faces: Selection; instance one plant on the points.
Compare overhead views at two seeds with density fixed.
cards.first_check: Preview the allowed-region mask before instancing: it is false on the path, true in the bed.
cards.check: Count forbidden plant centers at both seeds. If leaf clearance is required, inspect overhang separately.
cards.if_failed: Inspect the selection mask first; widen it for overhang only if the centers already pass.
cards.without_tools: Switch seeds yourself and inspect both path edges; I cannot verify clearance without the layouts.
cards.example: Change seed for another layout; change density for fewer plants.

cards.title: Test a prop after export
cards.choose_when: A prop must import or collide correctly in the receiving engine.
actions: Import the exported prop into the target engine and turn on its collision display.
Mark one spot that must block the player and one spot that must stay passable.
Run a hit and a miss in the engine; for a moving gate repeat in both poses.
cards.first_check: The engine's debug overlay shows a collision shape at the imported prop, not just the visible mesh.
cards.check: A player-sized probe hits the solid region and passes the designated opening. A render is not this test.
cards.if_failed: Inspect the collision shape at the failed position, not the render mesh.
cards.without_tools: Try the blocked and clear positions in your engine; I cannot verify collision in Blender alone.
cards.example: Use one hull for a solid crate, multiple hulls for a traversable handle.

cards.title: Time a looping motion
cards.choose_when: The poses work individually but the movement hesitates or pops.
actions: Key the start, extreme and return poses of a swinging arm.
Add a breakdown pose along the swing arc.
Play at delivery frame rate across the loop seam.
cards.first_check: Scrub the three keyed frames: the extreme differs, and the last pose matches the first.
cards.check: The arm follows the arc without an extra held beat at the seam.
cards.if_failed: End playback one frame before the duplicate start pose.
cards.without_tools: Play the loop twice yourself; I cannot verify timing from pose stills.
cards.example: Keep a repeated pose for an intentional hold; omit the duplicate endpoint from a seamless loop.

cards.title: Separate cel shadow bands
cards.choose_when: The face needs graphic shadow shapes rather than a smooth gradient.
actions: In EEVEE, connect white Diffuse BSDF to Shader to RGB, then Color to Color Ramp Fac.
Set the ramp to Constant; send its colors through Emission to Material Output.
Turn the face under a fixed key and inspect adjacent frames at thumbnail size.
cards.first_check: In EEVEE, trace the two links from Diffuse through Shader to RGB into the ramp's Fac input.
cards.check: Light and shadow stay distinct on the cheek without a one-frame flash.
cards.if_failed: Move the ramp threshold away from the flickering cheek value.
cards.without_tools: Scrub the turn yourself in EEVEE; I cannot verify band stability from the node list.
cards.example: Use Shader to RGB in EEVEE; test Toon BSDF separately for Cycles.

cards.title: Choose a daylight shadow edge
cards.choose_when: Framing is settled; the shot needs harder or softer shadows.
actions: Lock the camera, exposure, Sun direction and strength.
Render the same floor shadow twice, changing only Sun Angle.
Compare the shadow edges at the intended image size.
cards.first_check: Save the baseline frame and note which floor edge the shadow crosses before changing any light setting.
cards.check: The softer version has a wider transition along the same floor joint.
cards.if_failed: Compare a crop where direct sunlight crosses the joint.
cards.without_tools: Render both angles yourself and compare the same crop; I cannot verify the edge width without images.
cards.example: Favor a narrow edge to emphasize repeated bays, a broad edge to quiet the floor pattern.

cards.title: Isolate elbow weights
cards.choose_when: A joint pinches or drags nearby vertices in a still pose.
actions: Place the elbow pivot in Armature Edit Mode.
Match deform-bone names to vertex groups on the mesh with its Armature modifier.
Bend the elbow in Pose Mode and compare with rest.
cards.first_check: Inspect front and side views in rest pose: the hinge sits at the intended bend in both.
cards.check: The forearm follows the bone; the upper sleeve stays put away from the joint.
cards.if_failed: Remove stray forearm weights from the upper sleeve.
cards.without_tools: Pose one elbow yourself and inspect the sleeve; I cannot verify deformation from bone names alone.
cards.example: Test a still bend for skinning; retime keys only if the bend itself is clean.

cards.title: Isolate a correction with a matte
cards.choose_when: The rendered shot works except for one object’s color.
actions: Enable the Object Cryptomatte pass in View Layer Properties and render.
Pick the object with a Cryptomatte node in the Compositor.
Use its Matte as the Mix factor between the original and corrected images.
cards.first_check: The new Render Result includes the Object Cryptomatte passes for the active view layer.
cards.check: At full resolution the object changes color while its neighbor retains the original color.
cards.if_failed: Remove the neighbor’s ID from the matte selection.
cards.without_tools: Toggle the Mix result against the original yourself; I cannot verify edge spill without the images.
cards.example: Mask the sign to brighten its lettering; raise exposure only if the whole shot needs it.
